engine_under_test: our deployed API on main fae3e44
why: The maintainer refused the 'Google is closed' conclusion and asked for different experiments. It was right: the earlier rounds varied the ROUTE (/wml, endpoint shapes) and the EGRESS, but never crossed ENGINE x HOST x EGRESS on the ordinary /search path. Crossed here, one variable at a time.
headline: A working recipe exists today: camoufox + www.google.com + the host's own egress (no proxy) -> 11 of 11 runs returned a real SERP (8-12 h3 titles, 14-68 /goto links) across four different queries, EN and RU, in 5.7-7.6 s.

engine.chromium: block 3/3 direct, same url and settings
engine.note: the 2026-09-02 record had the opposite verdict (camoufox walled 24/24, stealth-off chromium through); the balance has flipped

host.www.google.de / www.google.co.uk / www.g: block 4/4 even on the passing egress
host.note: google.am is geographically COHERENT with this host's Armenian egress and is still refused, so it is the ccTLD itself, not a geo mismatch

egress.prem_res_rotating DE/GB/US: 1 pass in ~15 runs (one sticky DE), i.e. effectively burned for browser sessions

settings_that_do_NOT_matter.session_type=sticky: 0/7 on DE/GB/US -- the single earlier pass did not reproduce

camoufox_direct_com_rate_ceiling.note: stop rule was three consecutive blocks; it never triggered, so this is a floor, not the ceiling

shipped_recipe_end_to_end.caveat: locale=us only; the other five locales ship the new .com shape unmeasured end to end

shopping_specific.note: The 11/11 and the 20/20 are WEB SEARCH (no udm). Shopping's evidence is narrower: the 09-17 sweep's single Google pass in 24 runs was google_shopping_camoufox/us, and the 09-18 end-to-end run returned 62 products with prices. No udm=28 run was made through the isolation matrix.

also_open_without_js.news.google.com/rss/search: 200, 39-100 real items with titles and sources, answers non-news queries too (ozon.ru 39, python asyncio 20); link targets are news.google.com wrappers that are NOT plain-base64 decodable and follow into a consent page
also_open_without_js.scholar.google.com/scholar: 10 real results on 1 of 3 queries, one 429, one empty -- rate-limited but not JS-walled

caveats: n=11 on one host on one day; the passing egress is this host's own address, so volume is bounded by what that address can spend before it too is refused -- untested. Nothing here says the proxied pool cannot be made to work with a different exit class; it says the one we have is refused for browser sessions today.

consequences_not_measured.attempt_budget: `proxy_type: none` resolves to DirectSession, whose max_attempts() is 1 (src/proxy/resolver.py), so these four presets are now SINGLE-ATTEMPT: the rotate-on-selector-miss recovery they document (tests/presets/test_google_search_interstitial.py) can no longer fire for Google.
consequences_not_measured.geo_pin: `proxy_country: GB` on the `us` locale no longer routes anything, but the materializer still emits proxy_geo from it, so the browser is pinned en-GB/Europe/London over this host's own address. The 31 passes were measured WITHOUT that pin (bare /scrape/page, no proxy_geo).
consequences_not_measured.search_endpoint: /search?engine=google moved from the chromium twin to the camoufox twin in the same change.
consequences_not_measured.SUPERSEDED_2026_09_22: Review on #136: the chromium twins went back to the pool, so only the two camoufox twins are single-attempt; and on the direct path the locale's proxy_country no longer applies, so `us` pins the market country (en-US), not the GB exit's en-GB/Europe/London.

scope_of_the_31.what_it_is: 31 requests from ONE address -- this dev host's own (AS44395 Ucom, residential AM) -- over one afternoon: 11 across the isolation scripts and 20 in the sequential series.
scope_of_the_31.what_it_is_not: Not 31 addresses, and not evidence about a production server: a different host has a different address with its own reputation, and nothing here measures it. Treat it as 'the recipe can work from a clean address', not as 'it will work in production'.
scope_of_the_31.reproducibility: The 20-run series was run from a scratch script that was not committed with the record (review on #136, 2026-09-22); it is committed now as google_reopened_2026_09_18_ceiling.py, unchanged. Its stop rule was three consecutive blocks and never fired, so 20/20 is a floor for that cadence, not a ceiling.

shipped_config_end_to_end_2026_09_23.what: The exact configuration this PR ships, through /scrape/preset/page on the deployed branch head: camoufox twins, direct egress, market-country pin. Script: google_reopened_2026_09_23_shipped_config.py.

runs.note: repeat of the failed run: final_url /sorry/index, block heuristic fired

shipped_config_end_to_end_2026_09_23.reading: The recipe still answers from this host's address, and the pin now matches the market (en-US, de-DE, ru-RU; zone Asia/Yerevan from the host). But this is the first day the address itself was refused: /sorry on 2 of 8, against 39 of 39 on 09-18..09-20. That is the caveat about 31/31 made concrete -- the address's budget is finite and unmeasured, and every one of these presets is single-attempt, so a refusal is final. Nothing here says how fast the address recovers or what spends it.
